overnightPermit.what: Free self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit
overnightPermit.where: Fill one out at the trailhead kiosk and carry it with you.

overnightPermit.what: North Cascades NP backcountry permit for the cross-country zone, with a fee
overnightPermit.where: Reserve on Recreation.gov, then get the permit by email or in person at the Marblemount Wilderness Information Center; walk-up permits are issued there the day of or the day before.
